subject: dsa
title: Single Number
summary: XOR every element together. A value XORed with itself is 0, so each duplicated pair cancels out and only the number that appears once is left standing.
problem: Every element appears exactly twice except for one. Find that single number using O(1) extra space.

steps.caption: Every number appears twice except one. XOR them all: a value XORed with itself is 0, so the pairs vanish and the loner is left.
Start with x = 0 and XOR in 4. x = 4.
XOR in 1: x = 5. Then XOR in 2: x = 7.
XOR in the second 1. It cancels the first 1 (1 ^ 1 = 0), so x drops back to 6.
XOR in the second 2. It cancels the first 2, so x = 4. Both pairs are gone.
Only the unpaired 4 ever contributed without being cancelled. The single number is 4.
